The proposal records possible saved-setting changes and unknown exact rollback, forbids automatic retries or firmware/EEPROM intervention, and requires admitted committed implementation before execution. This checkpoint prepares the test without claiming command acceptance, measured RF or readiness of the broader RF integration gate.
